title: CAFE: Self-Improving Search Agents Need Co-Evolving Feedback
title_zh: CAFE：自我改进的搜索智能体需要协同演化的反馈
abstract_en: Outcome-supervised search agents learn when and how to retrieve evidence, but terminal rewards neither localize intermediate errors nor redirect an ongoing trajectory before those errors compound. Treating corrective feedback as a learned in-trajectory intervention couples the two roles: the agent must decide when to request and use feedback, while the critic must infer useful corrections from outcome-confounded rollouts whose failure patterns shift as the agent improves. We introduce CAFE (Coupled Agent--Feedback Evolution), a framework in which a shared-parameter model alternates between search-agent and critic roles. CAFE initializes feedback-conditioned recovery from trajectories built around the base agent's own failures, then couples online and offline optimization. During online RL, a comparative feedback estimate uses a prompt-level call--skip success gap to shape request returns, while feedback-aware advantage shaping reweights token advantages before and after feedback. Offline, rollout-derived preference optimization learns feedback from matched successful and unsuccessful trajectories. On seven agentic search benchmarks, CAFE outperforms the evaluated RL-based search agents on average, retains its gains across all six out-of-domain benchmarks, and reduces answer-level hallucinations. One-sided ablations show that improving only the agent or only the critic eventually plateaus, whereas alternating the two updates continues to improve performance. These findings suggest that a self-improving search agent needs feedback that co-evolves with the policy it guides.
abstract_zh: 基于结果监督的搜索智能体能够学习何时以及如何检索证据，但终局奖励既无法定位中间步骤中的错误，也无法在错误累积前及时纠正当前轨迹。CAFE（Coupled Agent–Feedback Evolution）将纠正性反馈建模为轨迹内的可学习干预：智能体负责决定何时请求并使用反馈，critic 则需从受最终结果混杂影响、且失败模式持续变化的 rollout 中推断有效修正。CAFE 使用共享参数模型交替扮演搜索智能体与 critic，并基于基础智能体自身的失败轨迹初始化反馈条件下的恢复能力，随后结合在线与离线优化。在线强化学习阶段，CAFE 根据同一 prompt 下调用与跳过反馈的成功率差异估计反馈价值，以塑造反馈请求的回报；同时通过反馈感知的优势塑形，重新加权反馈前后的 token 优势。离线阶段，模型利用匹配的成功与失败轨迹进行偏好优化，从 rollout 中学习反馈。在七个智能体搜索基准上，CAFE 的平均表现优于所评估的 RL 搜索智能体，并在六个分布外基准上保持增益，同时减少答案级幻觉。单侧消融实验表明，仅优化智能体或仅优化 critic 最终都会进入平台期，而交替更新二者可持续提升性能。
key_points_zh: 将纠正性反馈作为可学习的轨迹内干预，使搜索智能体能在错误累积前主动请求并利用反馈。
采用共享参数模型交替承担搜索智能体和 critic 角色，使策略及其反馈机制随训练协同演化。
在线 RL 通过调用—跳过反馈的成功率差塑造请求回报，并用反馈感知的优势塑形调整反馈前后的 token 学习信号。
离线阶段从匹配的成功与失败 rollout 中进行偏好优化，学习更具针对性的纠正反馈。
CAFE 在七个搜索基准上取得更高平均性能，在六个分布外基准上保持增益，并降低答案级幻觉。

llm_assessment.comment: CAFE presents a strong closed-loop search-agent training paradigm in which trajectory-grounded corrective feedback co-evolves with the policy it improves.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: CAFE提出了强有力的闭环搜索智能体训练范式，使基于轨迹的纠正反馈与其所改进的策略共同演化。
